newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates tumble as new crop arrives.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates tumble as new crop arrives.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates slid 181.50 rupees, or 6.93 percent, to 2,436.50 per maund (37.32 kg) on higher than expected arrivals of new cotton from the 1996/97 crop (July-June), brokers said on Sunday.
"Prices crashed after arrival of cotton at ginneries jumped to 20,000 375-lb bales compared to earlier estimates of 10,000 bales," broker Nasim Usman said.
He said rates were likely to open sharply lower on Monday and remain depressed for the next few days.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety closed at 2,000 rupees.
